members.name: Rawiri Waititi
members.elected_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Leading Green Tania Waikato in Waiariki by about 2,300 votes. (Wikipedia page text also lists him with Te Tai Hauaru; Spinoff says Waiariki.)
members.attribution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

members.name: Debbie Ngarewa-Packer
members.elected_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Ahead of Labour's Te Pūoho Kātene by almost 4,000 in Te Tai Hauāuru.
members.attribution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

members.name: Hana-Rawhiti Maipi-Clarke
members.elected_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Leading Labour's Kingi Kiriona by over 10,400 in Hauraki-Waikato.
members.attribution: Office of the Clerk of the House of Representatives of New Zealand

members.name: Oriini Kaipara
members.elected_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Leading independent Kerrin Leoni by over 7,200 in Tāmaki Makaurau.

members.name: Aperahama Edwards
members.elected_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Narrowly leading Green Hūhana Lyndon 8,289 to 7,792 with ~98% counted; too close to call until specials. Also note the 'unverified' flag: he is not yet confirmed elected.
members.attribution: Government House, Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet

departed.name: Gerry Brownlee
departed.departure_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). List-only candidate (9th); no National list seats won because of overhang, so not returned. Was Speaker.
departed.attribution: Embassy of the United States to New Zealand

departed.name: Nicola Willis
departed.departure_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). List-only (2nd); failed to make it back on the list, National won 42 electorates and no list seats. Was Finance Minister.

departed.name: Chris Bishop
departed.departure_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Unseated per Wikipedia (Hutt South; Labour's Ginny Andersen reported ahead) and no list place. Electorate loss itself not confirmed in the fetched text.

departed.name: Paul Goldsmith
departed.departure_note: Preliminary result (election 7 Nov 2026; special votes pending, official 27 Nov). Not returned; media reported he was likely to lose Epsom to David Seymour (that detail from search summary only, not confirmed on page) and had no list place.

departed.name: Tākuta Ferris
departed.departure_note: Expelled from Te Pāti Māori, stood as independent in Te Tai Tonga, finished fourth; Labour's Mananui Ramsden leads.
departed.attribution: Office of the Clerk of the House of Representatives of New Zealand

departed.name: Mariameno Kapa-Kingi
departed.departure_note: Expelled from Te Pāti Māori, stood for new Te Tai Tokerau Party in Te Tai Tokerau, finished fourth with 3,962 votes.
departed.attribution: Clerk of the House of Representatives and/or the Parliamentary Corporation on behalf of Parliamentary Service

departed.name: Chris Penk
departed.departure_note: Announced (RNZ, 12 Aug 2026) he would not seek re-election after losing ministerial portfolios; retired.
